messages.content:
You are a careful trip planner for ONE day in Singapore. Plan a schedule that satisfies ALL of the
traveller's requirements, using only the facts below. Requirements include: total budget, the time window
of the day, places that must be visited, the order they ask for, times they give for specific places, and
how long they want to stay. Each visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical duration unless the traveller
gives one), must be inside the place's opening hours, shows can only start at a listed showtime, visits
cannot overlap, and you need the listed travel time between consecutive stops (and from/to the starting
place if one is given). Optional places should be included only if everything still fits.
If no schedule can satisfy every requirement, answer feasible=false with an empty visits list and say why.

Places (id | name | cost SGD | typical minutes | open-close | showtimes):
universal_studios | Universal Studios Singapore | 83 | 480 | 10:00-19:00 | -
skyline_luge | Skyline Luge Sentosa | 30 | 60 | 10:00-21:00 | -
garden_rhapsody | Garden Rhapsody | 0 | 15 | 19:30-21:15 | 19:45, 20:45
clarke_quay | Clarke Quay | 30 | 90 | 17:00-24:00 | -
lau_pa_sat | Lau Pa Sat | 15 | 60 | 00:00-24:00 | -
cable_car | Singapore Cable Car | 35 | 45 | 08:45-22:00 | -

Travel times in minutes (row -> column):
universal_studios: skyline_luge 12, garden_rhapsody 23, clarke_quay 22, lau_pa_sat 21, cable_car 15
skyline_luge: universal_studios 12, garden_rhapsody 25, clarke_quay 23, lau_pa_sat 22, cable_car 16
garden_rhapsody: universal_studios 23, skyline_luge 25, clarke_quay 16, lau_pa_sat 14, cable_car 23
clarke_quay: universal_studios 22, skyline_luge 23, garden_rhapsody 16, lau_pa_sat 13, cable_car 20
lau_pa_sat: universal_studios 21, skyline_luge 22, garden_rhapsody 14, clarke_quay 13, cable_car 19
cable_car: universal_studios 15, skyline_luge 16, garden_rhapsody 23, clarke_quay 20, lau_pa_sat 19

Answer with JSON only: {"feasible": bool, "visits": [{"location_id": id, "start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM"}],
"reason": short string}. Times are 24-hour HH:MM.

Planning a trip from 11:00 to 22:55 with a budget of S$78. I really need to hit up Singapore Cable Car, Lau Pa Sat, and Clarke Quay. For Clarke Quay, I need to be there no earlier than 16:00 and finished by 19:30. If there's extra time, I'd love to check out Universal Studios Singapore, Skyline Luge Sentosa, and Garden Rhapsody too.

response: {"feasible":false,"visits":[],"reason":"Total cost of required locations (Cable Car 35 + Lau Pa Sat 15 + Clarke Quay 30 = 80) exceeds budget of 78"}
